title.note: Game title, glossary keep; Lithuanian players see Roblox titles in English.

hud.cast.note: Infinitive button, as Lithuanian UI writes buttons; 'užmesti meškerę' = cast the line. 7/8.

hud.reel.note: 'Traukti' = pull the line and fish in; 'Ištraukti' (pull out) is 9/8. Same root as the pass name Autotraukimas.

hud.bait_left.note: Genitive label (guide pattern 'Monetų: {count}') reads right for 0, 1 and 12; '{count} masalų' would be wrong for 1, 2-9 and 21.

catch.success.note: 'You caught: {fish} ({rarity})!' The colon lets the inserted nominative name stand after 'pagavai'; the parentheses keep the masculine tier from clashing with a future feminine fish (e.g. lydeka, pike).

catch.escaped.note: 'Nusprūdo' = slipped off the hook, the usual angling verb; generic 'žuvis' names the fish because Lithuanian needs a subject here.

catch.new_record.note: Developer: Lithuanian writes decimals with a comma (12,4 kg); {weight} arrives as 12.4, which reads foreign. Format it per locale in code.

fish.golden_carp.note: Literal. Not 'auksinis karosas', which is the name of a different real fish (crucian carp).

fish.lantern_eel.note: Built like 'elektrinis ungurys' (electric eel): žibintas = lantern, keeping the glow. Masculine like karpis. 18/18; shorter fallback 'Žibinto ungurys' (15).

rarity.mythic.note: Guide tier set: Retas, Epinis, Legendinis, Mitinis; masculine tier form, reads above Legendinis.

shop.equip.note: Button 'use' in the infinitive; pairs with the label 'Naudojama'. 'Užsidėti' fits clothing, not a rod.

shop.equipped.note: State 'in use'; the feminine participle agrees with meškerė (and matches the neuter form).

shop.free.note: 'Nemokama' agrees with meškerė, 8/8; the adverb 'Nemokamai' is 9/8.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same root as hud.reel 'Traukti'. 'Automatinis traukimas' is 21/14, so a joined auto- compound (like 'autopilotas'), 13/14. The store name in Creator Hub should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Sėkmės masalas padvigubina tikimybę pagauti retą žuvį!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Sėkmės masalas' = luck + bait, the glossary words (guide pattern 'Sėkmės eliksyras'). 'tavo' dropped, as Lithuanian does.

sell.all.note: 14/12: shortest natural wording; 'Parduoti' alone loses 'all'. Needs a slightly wider button or TextScaled.

sell.done.note: 'You sold fish: 12. You got coins: 340!' Two label sentences because 1, 2-9, 10-20 and 21 take different noun forms; the past-tense verbs are genderless.

sell.prompt.note: Compact prompt form with spaced en dash (guide). 'Spausk E, kad parduotum' is 23/21. Developer: ProximityPrompt ActionText 'Parduoti' would also serve touch and console.

ascend.button.note: 'Pakilti' = rise (in rank), as in 'pakilti pareigose'; not 'atgimti' (rebirth) and nothing religious. Same verb in ascend.confirm. Native check: could also read as 'take off'.

ascend.confirm.text: Pakilti dabar? Pradėsi iš naujo, bet retas žuvis gaudysi {bonus} % dažniau.
ascend.confirm.note: Same 'Pakilti' as the button. Percent with a non-breaking space (Lithuanian '25 %'), same form as friends.boost; use a plain space if the font is Fredoka One.

weather.storm.note: 'Kimba' is the fishing verb for biting; 'retos' matches the tier Retas.

quest.catch_n.note: Label form so 1, 2 and 10 all read right. Moonlit Bay = 'Mėnesienos įlanka' (locative here); in-world signs should use the same name.

friends.boost.note: Statement 'Fishing with friends gives +10 % luck'; partitive 'sėkmės'. Non-breaking space before %, as in ascend.confirm.

trade.sent.note: 'You offered a trade to player {player}': the noun 'žaidėjui' carries the dative so the name stays unchanged. 'Mainų prašymas išsiųstas žaidėjui' is 35/33.

trade.accept.note: '{player} agreed to trade'; the past tense is genderless and the name stays the subject.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Code accepted! The prize is yours.' 'Kodas panaudotas' can read as 'already used' (an error), and 'Mėgaukis prizu' sounds translated.

afk.kicked.text: Per ilgai nieko nedarei, todėl žvejyba sustojo.
afk.kicked.note: 'You did nothing for too long, so fishing stopped.' Avoids the gendered 'neaktyvus/neaktyvi'; no mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: Label form, 14/14 (guide's event pattern). Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Lithuanian needs '2 d. 4 val.' (English unit letters read wrong; 'm.' means years).

daily.streak.text: Dienų serija: {day}! Grįžk rytoj ir gausi daugiau prizų.
daily.streak.note: 'Day streak: 3! Come back tomorrow and you will get more prizes.' The label avoids number and ordinal agreement on {day}; 'prizų' spells out 'for more'.

tip.night.text: Patarimas: kai kurios žuvys kimba tik naktį.
tip.night.note: Lowercase after the colon (Lithuanian rule); 'kimba' = take the bait.

group.join.text: Prisijunk prie bendruomenės ir gauk 50 masalų nemokamai!
group.join.note: 'bendruomenė' = Roblox Communities, the name the English UI shows (guide); '50 masalų' is correct for the fixed 50. 56/60.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight. The fishing idiom 'Didžiausias laimikis' is 20/18.
